selected_observations.excerpt:
Counterparty: Oakfield Logistics GmbH
Effective: 1 September 2018
Term: rolling 12-month periods.
Oakfield rebranded in 2023 from Oakfield Logistics GmbH to Oakfield Logistik GmbH. Companies House / Handelsregister number HRB 88421 did not change. CRM still shows the old English-facing name.

selection_rationale: Governing-contract judgment for INV-3001 and MSA-OAK-2018 uses the invoice billed_name, the named contract counterparty, and any explicit commercial-notes statement tying invoices to that agreement.
known_missing_information: world.sqlite is not present in workspace; compiled identity_judgment tuples from prior passes cannot be queried via TaskView.
No invoice-level contract reference field in billing source; governing contract must be inferred from counterparty name chain or commercial notes.
Oakfield contract header uses 'Logistics' while invoices use 'Logistik'; rebrand note is required to bridge names.
